root_cause: The charge pick compares a probability-weighted target value (score = chance x target value, inflated by order_round_aggression x1.3, on-objective x1.5, points-trade and kill bonuses) against a 'don't charge' bar that is a near-constant 0.19-0.54 (1.0 x early-round 0.5 x Ork aggression / tempo cuts). Nothing on the don't-charge side counts what the charger loses for the REST of the game: (a) overwatch damage, paid on every declaration made or failed (s7467: Allarus 270 pts into 7.2 expected overwatch dmg = 40% of the unit for a 17% shot at a 55-pt Mek; the overwatch multiplier only cut 6.7 -> 1.6, still 7x the 0.23 bar); (b) on success, being locked beside a single model that survives and fights back (s7469: Stormboyz 'expected 8.9 dmg vs 7 HP' at a T7 2+/4++ Blade Champion - the estimate counts the Kustom Choppa on all 10 models via the _weapon_carrier_count fallback and 'Choppas' vs '9x Choppa' wargear mismatch, real ~2.9 - so ch_can_wipe/halve fired and ch_retaliation was skipped; a wounded character keeps its full OC/attacks, nothing lasts, and in branch A the Custodes heroically intervened and 3-4 units charged the Stormboyz, which then missed round-3 Death Trap actions: B gained +7/+2 trapped_score in r3, A 0). The guardrails where charging was right are the lasting cases: s7431 r3 the Blade Champion was at 1 wound (kill ratio 10 -> the target is gone, objective freed), s7403 Battlewagon at 42% (not long odds).
fix_summary: FIX_CHARGE_LOW_ODDS (default 1.0, 0 = base exactly) in _evaluate_best_charge via new _charge_low_odds_stake(): for a charge under 34% (9+ on 2D6) before battle round 5, the candidate's score is zeroed (logged [CHARGE_LOW_ODDS], term ch_low_odds_stake) when the charger's later rounds outweigh what lasts: CH-OW-TOLL expected overwatch >= 25% of the charger's wounds AND its points > chance x target points; CH-NO-LASTING single-model target, expected damage < 2x its wounds, it fights back >= 1 dmg; CH-LOSING-TRADE multi-model target, no confident kill, fight-back points off the charger (all its points if the fight-back would destroy it) > points removed (dmg x target points/wound). Exempt: confident kills (dmg >= 2x wounds), cheap chargers at targets worth > 2x them (deliberate tie-ups), battle round 5, charges at >= 34%.

fires: [CHARGE_LOW_ODDS] veto lines per one-round replay game (both players, every unit re-evaluation counted): f1 22, f2 45, g1 7, g2 15, g3 12, g4 5, g5 132, g6 12. Most are CH-OW-TOLL on options already far below the bar (score < 1); vetoes of candidates scoring >= 1.0 (likely real decision changes): f1 4, f2 3, g1 5, g2 6, g3 11, g4 5, g5 4, g6 4. Mix: OW-TOLL dominates in Ork games (Lootas/Battlewagon overwatch), NO-LASTING/LOSING-TRADE in Custodes games (Blade Champions, Custodian Guard vs Custodian Guard).
risks: Full game: (1) a charge that was vetoed leaves the unit unlocked and alive, so it keeps moving/acting in its next turn - good for action primaries (Death Trap booby traps) and spread secondaries (Engage on All Fronts, Centre Ground); unlike FAR_TRIP/OVERCOMMIT it never holds a unit back in the movement phase, it only removes a long-odds charge declared after movement, and a failed 11e charge does not move the unit anyway, so positions for later secondaries are unchanged. (2) Lost upside: fewer surprise 9+ charges that land; kill secondaries (Assassination on characters, Bring It Down on vehicles: CH-NO-LASTING also vetoes long shots at single-model vehicles/monsters) score less when the AI no longer gambles on non-confident kills; confident kills (dmg >= 2x wounds) are kept. (3) Tie-ups lost: a long-odds charge that would lock a shooter or an objective holder is skipped unless the charger is cheap (< half the target's points). (4) Round 3-4: more units stay out of combat; Custodes mirror replays show many CG-vs-CG and Allarus-vs-Blade-Champion vetoes, so expect fewer mid-game brawls there; it switched g4 to a different 28% target, unmeasured. Round 5 is exempt entirely (late objective-grab charges keep the base behaviour). (5) The kill-confidence test relies on _estimate_melee_damage, which overstates units whose sergeant weapon is counted on every model (Stormboyz Kustom Choppa); that is why f1 falls back to a Custodian Guard charge instead of no charge - a damage-model fix would close it. (6) OW-TOLL uses the AI's overwatch estimate (best single shooter, opponent CP >= 1); where that estimate is high, nearly all long-odds charges of the exposed unit are dropped.
